work.heading: Things I've
work.subheading: A few projects I'm proud of, from university work to personal builds. Each one taught me something new.

projects.name: Peertube
projects.subtitle: Peer Tutoring System
projects.description: A scalable peer tutoring platform with session management, financial dashboards, refund/report features, and payment integration.
bullets: Integrated full-text search, payment flow, Firebase notifications, Resend email, Google OAuth, real-time chat, and automated tasks, while optimizing performance with Supabase queues, server-side prefetching, and SSR for SEO.

projects.name: Trideo
projects.subtitle: Learning Analytic System
projects.description: A full-stack video learning platform with admin dashboards to track user activities — visits, views, and completions.
bullets: Implemented Google OAuth with Passport.js, video uploads with Cloudinary and Multer, event streaming with Kafka (Confluent Cloud), and background processing with a dedicated Kafka worker.

projects.name: Asset Borrowing System
projects.subtitle: Mobile App
projects.description: A mobile asset management app for booking, borrowing, and returning assets with role-based workflows for users, lecturers, and staff.
bullets: Implemented JWT authentication, email OTP verification, automated asset status updates with node-schedule, and image uploads using Cloudinary and Multer.

projects.name: Salary Prediction
projects.subtitle: ML Model
projects.description: A machine learning model that predicts whether an individual falls into a high-salary category based on their demographic, educational, and employment information.
bullets: Developed and evaluated ANN-based classification models with regularization, bagging, feature selection, and PCA, while preprocessing missing, categorical, duplicate, and irrelevant features.
